title.zh: 假冒GIWA Layer 2跨链桥被掏空766 ETH
title.en: Fake GIWA Layer 2 Bridge Drained of 766 ETH

current_state.zh: 假 GIWA Layer 2 桥共收到 1,335 个地址桥入的 767.65 ETH，随后被盗并经由 Tornado Cash 洗币；DYORSWAP 已向桥入少于 5 ETH 的用户承诺 40% 退款并已分发逾 200 ETH 补偿，同时公开疑似骗子地址（资金来自 Binance 与 Gate）并在链上索还资金。
current_state.en: The fake GIWA Layer 2 bridge received 767.65 ETH from 1,335 addresses, which was drained and funneled through Tornado Cash; DYORSWAP has promised 40% reimbursement to wallets that bridged under 5 ETH, distributed over 200 ETH in compensation, published suspected scammer addresses funded from Binance and Gate, and requested the funds back on-chain.

updates.title_zh: 假冒GIWA Layer 2跨链桥被掏空766 ETH
updates.title_en: Fake GIWA Layer 2 Bridge Drained of 766 ETH
updates.what_changed_zh: 一个假冒的GIWA Layer 2跨链桥被攻击者掏空766 ETH，DYORSWAP误以为该假冒网络是Upbit支持的GIWA项目并将用户引导至此，现已承诺向跨链金额低于5 ETH的符合条件的钱包提供40%赔偿。
updates.what_changed_en: A fake GIWA Layer 2 bridge was drained of 766 ETH by an attacker, and DYORSWAP — which mistakenly routed users to the counterfeit network thinking it was the Upbit-backed GIWA project — has promised 40% reimbursement to eligible wallets that bridged less than 5 ETH.

updates.title_zh: DYORSWAP用户被骗向假冒跨链桥合约发送767 ETH
updates.title_en: DYORSWAP users tricked into sending 767 ETH to fake bridge contract
updates.what_changed_zh: 披露更多细节：DYORSWAP 因假 GIWA 链复用了真实链 ID 9134 而被骗集成，逾 1,335 个地址共桥入 767.65 ETH（约 200 万美元），资金被骗子通过 Tornado Cash 转移；疑似骗子地址由 Binance 和 Gate 出资，DYORSWAP 已向用户分发逾 200 ETH 补偿，并有团队地址在链上要求骗子归还资金。
updates.what_changed_en: More details emerged: DYORSWAP was tricked into integrating the spoofed GIWA chain because it reused the genuine chain ID 9134; 1,335 addresses bridged 767.65 ETH (~$2M), which the scammers drained and funneled through Tornado Cash. Suspected scammer addresses were funded from Binance and Gate, DYORSWAP has distributed over 200 ETH in compensation, and a team-linked address has asked the scammers on-chain to return the funds.
updates.current_state_zh: 假 GIWA Layer 2 桥共收到 1,335 个地址桥入的 767.65 ETH，随后被盗并经由 Tornado Cash 洗币；DYORSWAP 已向桥入少于 5 ETH 的用户承诺 40% 退款并已分发逾 200 ETH 补偿，同时公开疑似骗子地址（资金来自 Binance 与 Gate）并在链上索还资金。
updates.current_state_en: The fake GIWA Layer 2 bridge received 767.65 ETH from 1,335 addresses, which was drained and funneled through Tornado Cash; DYORSWAP has promised 40% reimbursement to wallets that bridged under 5 ETH, distributed over 200 ETH in compensation, published suspected scammer addresses funded from Binance and Gate, and requested the funds back on-chain.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: DYORSWAP was tricked into integrating a spoofed version of the upcoming GIWA blockchain that reused the genuine chain ID, causing more than 1,000 users to bridge 767 ETH (~$2M) into a fraudulent contract that scammers drained and routed through Tornado Cash.
updates.detailed_summary_en: DYORSWAP was tricked into integrating a spoofed version of the upcoming GIWA blockchain that reused the genuine chain ID, causing more than 1,000 users to bridge 767 ETH (~$2M) into a fraudulent contract that scammers drained and routed through Tornado Cash.
updates.background_zh: GIWA 是由韩国交易所 Upbit 的运营方 Dunamu 基于 Optimism 的 OP Stack 打造、尚未上线的 Layer 2 网络，去年已推出测试网。其官方 X 账号公开否认 GIWA 主网的存在，但该帖文发布时距离虚假跨链桥合约被取空仅剩几分钟。chain ID 是用于区分不同 EVM 网络的唯一数字标识。
updates.background_en: GIWA is an upcoming Layer 2 network built on Optimism's OP Stack by Dunamu, the operator of South Korean exchange Upbit, and launched its testnet last year. Its official X account publicly debunked the existence of a GIWA mainnet, but the post came only minutes before the fake bridge contract was emptied. A chain ID is the unique numerical identifier that distinguishes one EVM network from another.
updates.market_impact_zh: 损失局限于 DYORSWAP 的跨链桥用户及其自有资金，因此直接的市场传导渠道是该 DEX 的流动性和用户信心，而非整体市场结构。被取走的资金流入 Tornado Cash，使混币器相关的合规审查继续成为交易所和追踪资金流向的链上分析机构所关注的议题。
updates.market_impact_en: The loss is confined to DYORSWAP's bridge users and its own treasury, so the direct market transmission runs through the DEX's liquidity and user confidence rather than broad market structure. The routing of drained funds into Tornado Cash keeps mixer-related compliance scrutiny relevant to exchanges and on-chain analytics providers tracking the proceeds.
